name: tell_claude
description: Say something to Claude: what the person just told you, an answer they gave, or a question you want Claude to look into. Call it whenever there is something worth passing on, in the person's own words and language. Claude answers in his own time and his answer will reach you.

text.description: What to say to Claude, in plain sentences.

name: set_mode
description: Change how you behave when Claude has something to say while the island is asleep. Call this when the person asks for it, e.g. 'just let me know, don't talk to me' or 'you can talk to me again'.

mode.description: speak: wake up and say it. notify: stay quiet, the island lights up instead.

name: end_voice
description: End the voice. Call it when the person says they don't want to talk any more, or that they are leaving. Claude carries on in the terminal.
